method.title: Resolve the already installed Ruff through its owning Python module and retain lint findings
method.rollback: Stop selecting Ruff for this scope and retain every diagnostic and source file; do not change host profiles or PATH.

retained_negatives.failure: The bare Ruff executable was not present on PATH; the version and lint commands were both rejected before checking a file.
The first bounded system-Python Ruff check found twelve owner-source findings, principally import ordering plus one unnecessary generator.
Ruff's safe auto-fix corrected eleven findings but left the generator-comprehension finding; the immediate check therefore remained nonterminal.

recovery.procedure: Use the pre-existing system Python module entrypoint, apply only the eleven safe mechanical fixes, patch the remaining set comprehension and generator template, and rerun the same exact file allowlist.

boundary: Ruff validation is bounded owner-source evidence only; it is not exhaustive security, complete correctness, independent reproduction, production certification, or Stage 20 readiness.
